title: mean([]) raises ZeroDivisionError
body:
Calling calc.mean([]) crashes with ZeroDivisionError.
Expected: raise ValueError('mean of empty list').
Repro: python -c "import calc; calc.mean([])"

title: Add median() to calc
body: We need a median(xs) function next to mean(). Should handle even/odd length and raise ValueError on empty.

title: Why does mean return float for ints?
body: Question: mean([2,4]) returns 3.0 — is that intended? No code change requested.
